items.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23
items.q: Jim Fisher the same. ... He was old like Swan, Sonny Swan and Jim Fisher.

ctx.x: Thank you. Thank you. Thank you. Thank you. Thank you. Thank you. Thank you. Thank you. Thank you. Thank you. Warren told me, say, listen buddy, that's a good waltz, he said, but let's see. So he played it. And he played it different. Sounded good though, but it still wasn't like mine. And Jim Fisher the same. But they heard me play it, you know, and then they, of course I used to play plenty then, but I left it long, I haven't played piano I guess, almost 50 years, I haven't fooled with piano. Around 50 years.…
And this blues you played before, do you have a name for it?
